validation.parser: Tools/showroom/build-catalogue.py dat_mesh: hash verification, topology, finite coordinates; not a rendered visual inspection.
validation.metadata_note: dat_mesh hardcodes original-core source/license in its return value. Those metadata values were deliberately discarded for expansion geometry.

implementation: Use only edition-corresponding geometry and retain attribution and exact archive/model hashes.

Resolve like_ship and include geometric subentities with positions and quaternion rotations; handle both legacy string and dictionary forms. Ignore flashers as geometry. Normalize only after assembling the full ship.
Oolite profiles are community renditions, not native Frontier/FFE or Elite Dangerous statistics. Keep each edition/profile named.
Source shipdata is included for stronger estimates than a generic Cobra surrogate. Missing specifications may be estimated per user authorization, with an explicit basis and units.
Do not treat verified_geometry_reuse_terms_unresolved as permission-cleared import. These files establish the design and a concrete next source to resolve.

BBS OpenStep files use bare decimal values and some missing final semicolons rejected by macOS plutil. Research parser retained values as strings and parsed dictionaries/arrays; source files were not rewritten. Recheck imported gameplay values independently.
No game source, generated runtime resource, docs/research maintained input, README or media changed in this research pass.
